verdict.rationale: Notte offers API endpoints for scripts (serverless automations invocable and schedulable), a CLI, and remote/cloud browser sessions with CDP/Playwright compatibility, all of which support headless/CI-style automation without a GUI. However, there's no explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), Docker/self-host headless mode, or exit-code/logging conventions typical for CI tooling, and community feedback includes at least one hands-on failure report unrelated specifically to headless/CI use. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, headless mode flags/config, independent corroboration of CI usage.
